map.人身损害赔偿计算器 使用指南: Personal Injury Compensation Calculator User Guide
map.依据最高法人身损害赔偿司法解释计算（交通事故、打架斗殴、医疗事故等通用）: Computed from the judicial interpretation on personal injury compensation (general for traffic accidents, fights, medical malpractice and similar cases)
map.填写「城镇居民人均可支配收入（元/年）」。: Enter the urban per-capita disposable income (CNY/year).
map.填写「误工费月收入（元）」。: Enter the monthly income for lost wages (CNY).
map.交通事故、务工受伤等人身损害，估算医疗费、误工费、残疾赔偿金等合计。: Traffic accidents, work injuries and other personal injury cases, estimating medical costs, lost wages and disability compensation together.
map.残疾赔偿金按伤残等级系数 × 赔偿年限 × 城镇居民人均可支配收入。: Disability compensation = disability level factor x compensation years x urban per-capita disposable income.
map.区分责任比例，交强险限额内不分责。: Assign the liability share; within the compulsory insurance limits no fault split is applied.
map.：城镇居民人均可支配收入 5.2 万/年、年龄 40（年限 20）、十级系数 0: Urban per-capita disposable income of 52,000 CNY/year, age 40 (term 20 years), level-ten factor 0.1: disability compensation = 52,000 x 20 x 0.1 = 104,000 CNY; add medical costs, lost wages and the like as actually incurred.
map.：系数 1.0、同口径：死亡赔偿金 = 5.2万 × 20 × 1 = 1,04: With a factor of 1.0 and the same basis, death compensation = 52,000 x 20 x 1 = 1,040,000 CNY (under 60 years old); add funeral costs and dependents' living costs.
map.残疾赔偿金年限怎么定？: How is the disability compensation term set?
map.60 周岁以下按 20 年；60 以上每增 1 岁减 1 年；75 岁以上按 5: Under 60 years uses 20 years; above 60 subtract 1 year per additional year; above 75 use 5 years; the disability factor runs from 0.1 at level ten to 1.0 at level one.
map.被扶养人生活费算吗？: Is the dependent's living cost included?
map.算，计入残疾/死亡赔偿金一并主张；本工具提示未自动包含，需另行按被扶养人人数、年: Yes, include disability/death compensation in the claim; this tool notes they are not automatically included and must be computed separately by number of dependents, years and coefficient.
